create_kinematic_humanoid: create a KinematicHumanoid agent with agent_cfg and sim to instantiate a humanoid in the scene
set_joint_transform: set the humanoid joint positions, offset transform, and base transform using set_joint_transform
get_joint_transform: get the current joint positions and base transformation of the humanoid via get_joint_transform
set_base_pos: set the humanoid base ground position to a desired Vector3 coordinate using the base_pos setter
set_rest_position: reset the humanoid agent to its resting position by calling set_rest_position
